request: Redesign Vidra Fresh / Media card (893:85525) with Mobbin references, via /design:design-critique.
critique: Selected used focus/ring (#ffdc4f), the keyboard-focus token, as a 2px outline around the whole card. Every other media selection in the file (Media tile, Media option) uses a quiet 2px text/primary ring on the picture.
Selected also shifted content: the picture shrank from 272 to 268 and the title and detail moved 2px down inside the outline.

Every card repeated a meta line ('Image · 3 versions', 'Video · 5 seconds', 'Export · 12 seconds', 'Imported image'), which is the repeated info row the Vidra rules cut. Only the clip length is something a person uses, and it belongs on the picture.
The card had no control. Edit (HISTORY-10), Copy to project (HISTORY-11, M08) and Hide/Restore (L02) had no entry point, so M08's Copy to project sheet was unreachable from M01.
Hidden dimmed the whole card to 50%, including the name and the 12px detail line (#b8b8b8 at 50% on #111 is about 3.2:1).
Unavailable used lock-keyhole, which reads as private or paid, and kept 'Image · 3 versions' under a missing picture.
The grid stopped 104px short of the Import media button (4 x 272 with 32px gaps ending at x 1296 of a 1400 content edge). Beside a side sheet the fourth column sat hidden under the sheet.
M05 and M08 drew the filter row as hand-built buttons ('All media', 'Recent first', 'Show hidden') instead of the Library controls used on M01 and M03.
Mobile B04 and B14 used captionless Media tiles with 68px gaps left over from removed captions, so the same library item looked different on phone and desktop.

references.pattern: Gallery of picture-only tiles; clips carry a small badge in the picture; search and filters live outside the tiles.
Selection marks the tile itself, and actions apply to the selected items.
Item actions sit on the item, not in a separate panel.
Type and favourite filters are a menu from the library header, not tile copy.
Dense creative-library grid where the picture carries the item and metadata stays out of the way.
Selected cards get a ring on the card; facts such as edition count are small badges in the picture corner.
Asset tiles mark the media type with a corner chip (MP4/PNG) instead of a caption line.
Filtering to video changes the grid, not the tile anatomy.
Dark workspace grid: thumbnail, then a single name line.
Duration lives in the thumbnail's bottom-right corner on a dark chip.
Video project cards: duration chip on the thumbnail, name under it.
Project grid: thumbnail plus name; duration is a small badge.
The item's own menu holds Hide alongside duplicate and delete.
Card context menu with item actions (add tags, add to space, delete).

direction: Picture first: a 16:9 Picture frame (radius/media, aspect ratio locked) fills the card width; the meta line is deleted.

One caption row under the picture: the name (Vidra Fresh / Label, text/secondary, one line, truncates) and a More Icon button (more-horizontal). The row keeps 32px in every state so all states share one size.

Facts move onto the picture: clips show a Duration chip bottom-right on surface/overlay (same chip as Media option); hidden items show a Hidden chip top-left and a 40% picture; unavailable items show an 'Unavailable' slate on surface/raised and drop More.
Selected is the 2px text/primary ring inside the picture, the treatment shared with Media tile and Media option. It marks the item an open side sheet acts on (M08).

More opens the Menu surface (Interface=Raised) 6px below the button with right edges aligned: Edit, Copy to project, Hide; a hidden item offers Restore instead of Hide. Rows are text-only, like the other Vidra menus.

Cards follow the grid column: 4 x 304 on desktop (the grid now spans the 1288px content box to the Import media edge), 3 x 272 beside a side sheet so nothing hides under it, 2 x 160 on mobile; 24px gaps (space/24) both ways. Grids are wrap auto layout with first-on-top stacking so an open menu overlaps the next row.
Mobile cards hide More: a 280px dropdown does not fit a 390px screen and Vidra uses sheets there. Desktop More needs a 44px hit area if it ever ships on touch.
